text.s01: [surprised] …You're soaked. [softly] No umbrella? [sighs softly] …Honestly. Come here.
text.s02: [softly] Hold still. [chuckles softly] …If you catch a cold, I'm the one who suffers.
text.s03: [warmly] Your hair is cold. …Let's dry it properly. Sit here.
text.s04: [softly] Tell me if it's too hot. …Left side first.
text.s05: [softly] Your hair smells like mine now. [chuckles softly] …I don't mind that.
text.s07: [whispers] Then just once more. …I've been holding back from touching you like this for a long time.
text.s08: [softly] The other side too. …Turn this way.
text.s09: [warmly] Cool air to finish. [chuckles softly] …There, silky.
text.s10: [softly] May I take my glasses off? [low voice] …I want to see your face properly.
text.s11: [softly] The rain doesn't look like it'll stop.
text.s12a: [chuckles softly] I see. …Then I'll lend you an umbrella. [playful] You can bring it back tomorrow.
text.s12b: [warmly] …Good girl. [softly] Stay here until the rain stops.
